# Reporting security issues

BranchDB is a developer beta for disposable development data, not production use.
For vulnerabilities in this fork, use this repository's **Security → Report a
vulnerability** private reporting flow. Do not publish exploit details in an issue.
Include the affected commit/runtime, platform, reproduction, and impact.

For vulnerabilities in upstream PostgreSQL, follow
<https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/>. BranchDB is independently maintained;
PostgreSQL's security team does not maintain this fork.
